headline: QCOM Q2 Deep Dive: Data Center and Automotive Growth Offset Smartphone Headwinds
summary: Wireless chipmaker Qualcomm (NASDAQ:QCOM) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, but sales fell by 4% year on year to $9.95 billion. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $10.1 billion at the midpoint, 1% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.21 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.

headline: Microsoft's Cloud Blowout Powers Nasdaq, Then Apple And Amazon Split The Megacap Trade All Over Again
summary: The Nasdaq closed 2.8% higher on Thursday as Microsoft's Q4 blowout answered the AI-capex sceptics and dragged the entire cloud complex with it. After the bell, Amazon delivered another AWS acceleration while Apple's soft guidance sent the stock into an ugly after-hours print. PCE inflation cooled, Q2 GDP slowed, and the Fed sat still.
